I’m resubmitting with Galaxy’s nested conditional input structure and will require the provenance check to match before analysis.

Galaxy’s automatic input-format negotiation accepted the corrected conditional structure and the rerun is active. I’ll reject it as well unless the returned provenance confirms both the intended reference and tagged-read datasets plus the requested PAF output.

The negotiated alignment is taking longer than the invalid default run, which is consistent with it now indexing the intended 321 MB three-species reference and mapping all 1.47 million tagged cDNA reads. I’m continuing to wait on this single job.

Alignment remains active without a terminal error. Because Galaxy is doing an on-the-fly minimap2 index build, this is the expected long-running phase; no downstream classification will begin until its provenance and output type pass acceptance checks.
The same Galaxy mapping job is still running. I’m maintaining the requested blocking execution workflow and will continue once it reaches a terminal state.
